metadata.chemistry_scope: explicitly permitted mixed chemistry within assigned cohort
metadata.similarity_formula: 1 / (1 + RMS of common-metric robust standardized differences)
metadata.correlation_unit: one median summary per cell within cohort; repeated tests are collapsed
metadata.scaling: within-cohort median center; 1.4826*MAD, then IQR/1.349, then population SD; constants excluded
metadata.coverage_denominator: all informative selected metric dimensions within cohort
limitations: Descriptive similarity is not causality or statistical significance.
Only entities in the same explicitly assigned cohort are compared.
Cohort definitions must align protocol, units and life-index basis; temperature and explicitly permitted chemistry differences require interpretation.
Scale and network layout may change when new experiments are added.
Window endpoint coverage is required; no interpolation or extrapolation is performed.
Cell medians reduce repeated-test counting; other shared batch effects remain possible.
metadata.refresh: CLI watch process only; unchanged size/mtime uses cache. Use --verify-all for full content verification.

metadata.composition_basis: explicit per field: electrode_total or active_material_total; wt%
metadata.categorical_distance: 0 for exact equality, otherwise 1; no assumed chemical embedding
metadata.composition_distance: min(sum(abs(component differences))/200, 1); one weight per vector
metadata.coverage_denominator: total configured field weight including missing fields
limitations: Design similarity describes recorded conditions, not performance, causality or statistical significance.
Material and binder identities require separate categorical fields; matching wt% does not establish matching chemistry.
Numeric engineering scales and field weights are explicit assumptions supplied in configuration.
A missing composition component makes the entire vector missing; observed zero is a valid component value.
Composition percentages use the explicitly declared total electrode or total active-material mass basis; the two denominators are never inferred or converted.
Only the same design_group is compared; this grouping is distinct from the electrochemical cohort.
Pair coverage must be inspected because different missing fields can yield different comparison subsets.
metadata.population: all enabled registrations, including raw-pending tests
